q: Which coke and coal records does a ferro alloy plant need for its carbon figure?
title: Ferro alloy reductants: records to keep
short: For each reductant keep tonnes received, opening and closing stock, moisture, and fixed carbon or total carbon from a lab analysis. The mass balance needs carbon actually charged, so purchase invoices alone are not enough.
audience: Ferrochrome, ferromanganese and silico-manganese plants in Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Andhra Pradesh

ul: Purchase invoices and weighbridge slips for coke, coal, char and electrode paste.
Monthly stock counts, so consumption equals receipts plus opening minus closing stock.
Moisture per lot, because carbon content is measured on a dry basis.
Carbon content per lot or per month from your lab or the supplier's certificate.

p: Using total coke bought for the year without the stock change, or applying a book carbon content when lab results exist. Both move the figure by several per cent and a verifier will ask.
Carbon in the alloy from product analysis, and carbon in slag and dust if material. These are subtracted in the balance.
